notes.title: Game Anglia 2025
notes.content:
Hey Ruya Fans!

We’re happy to announce that we'll be attending [url=https://www.gameanglia.co.uk/]Game Anglia[/url] this year on the 6th of February in Ipswich! We'll showing off a brand new and updated version of the Ruya: Ascension exclusively at Game Anglia so make sure to come down!

We've been working hard since our open Beta launched to iron out any confusing elements in Ruya: Ascension and get everything polished up nicely for it's launch! We're excited to see how this version of the game will play and what people think so far.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/bfe560e4d1cebca37cb3a8a887137329ce12dd7f.png[/img]

You can find more information about [url=https://www.gameanglia.co.uk/]Game Anglia here![/url]

We'll be showcasing all day and our entire team will be there (Tom, Jake and Brad) to answer any questions you might have about the game. 👻

Hopefully see you there!

- Miracle Tea

notes.title: Ruya: Ascension Open Beta!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/945113085c8fe08ff24b245b264c4ece3249c9cd.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/bed2cf0b8daa52af7d59c93f8b51124a15d4a452.png[/img]

Hey [b]Ruya[/b] Fans!

We’re stoked to announce that we’re releasing a special sneak peek of [b]Ruya: Ascension[/b], and you are invited to be among the first to play it!

We've been working hard to configure a small slice of the game, just for this showcase. Your feedback is going to be crucial in helping us shape the game as we continue development. 👻

[h2]How to Play[/h2]
[list]
[*] Head over to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ][b]Discord[/b][/url].
[*] Click on the [url=https://discord.com/channels/559867136793772034/1246916957555527761][b]Ruya: Ascension Channel[/b][/url]
[*] You will find a special link in this channel where you'll be able to access the demo.
[/list]
[h2]Feedback & Questionnaire[/h2]
[list]
[*] We encourage you to leave comments on this early slice of the game!
[*] You can jump into our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3230930/discussions/]Steam Community forum[/url][/b] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] server and share your thoughts.
[*] We also have an anonymous [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdtlRt5u4sFJN_euSuF1jomVr3MjVM7K0mAkkU3JtXRn1xJWA/viewform?usp=header][b]questionnaire[/b][/url] for feedback to fill. It should only take 5 - 10 minutes and would really help us out.
[/list]
We’ll be keeping a close eye on everything you have to say!

- Miracle Tea

notes.title: Dev Update: Ruya: Ascension on the Steam Deck!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/945113085c8fe08ff24b245b264c4ece3249c9cd.png[/img]
Hey Ruya Fans!

We're excited to share a little behind the scenes news with you: [b]we've got our hands on a Steam Deck and we have Ruya: Ascension up and running on it![/b] Seeing our work on the deck has been so cool and we're looking forward for you to experience it yourself!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/f4ad9f8b23ec687f413656d75326f1fff09f3023.jpg[/img]

[h2]In Progress[/h2]
Our dev team is currently fine tuning the game to make sure it's a smooth experience on the Steam Deck. We've been focusing on the following areas for Ruya: Ascension's handheld play:

[list][*] [b]Controls:[/b] Ruya: Ascension is fully playable with the Steam Deck's touch screen but Jake's been busy working on refining controller support which will in turn cover the Deck's control scheme. We're aiming for a natural and responsive experience with its unique layout.
[*] [b]Performance:[/b] We're testing out different settings to ensure stable experience without sacrificing the visual experience.
[*] [b]Battery Life:[/b] For longer battery life on the Steam Deck Tom has been busy reducing draw calls in materials and batches which will help the to give the game more time on the go![/list]
[h2]Next Steps[/h2]
We'll be focusing on preparing Ruya: Ascension for the [b][url=https://partner.steamgames.com/doc/steamdeck/compat]Steam Deck Compatibility Review[/url][/b] and slowly working through all the requirements to make sure our game meets them all for that oh so sweet green tick next to our game! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/638508c54136e55f897a6dcb5955c86fbd20fff4.png[/img]

It's an exciting time, we’ll keep you posted as we make more progress, so stay tuned!

If you haven't already given [b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3230930/Ruya_Ascension/]Ruya: Ascension a Wishlist here on Steam[/url][/b], please do! It really helps us out. You can find us active in our our [b][url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3230930/discussions/]Steam Community forum[/url][/b] or [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] server so feel free to jump in and share your thoughts!

- Miracle Tea

notes.title: Ruya: Ascension - Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/945113085c8fe08ff24b245b264c4ece3249c9cd.png[/img]

[h2] Hey everyone! [/h2]

We're happy to announce [b]Ruya: Ascension[/b] a sequel to the original game from 2016!

[previewyoutube=EbnteAniaCw;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45282158/945113085c8fe08ff24b245b264c4ece3249c9cd.png[/img]

[h2] About Us [/h2]

Here's some general info about our team and the game!

We're [b][url=https://miracleteastudios.com/]Miracle Tea[/url][/b], a team of 3: Thomas (programmer), Jake (programmer) and Brad (artist). We're excited to be working on a follow up to the first Miracle Tea game from 2016! We've been working on the sequel since Jake started in May 2024 with a few days around jamming in March in preparation of the project.

If you haven't already, be sure to check out the original game: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/886380

Be sure to join us on [url=https://discord.com/invite/MYWmsNQ][b]Discord[/b][/url] to keep up to date with the game's development:

- Miracle Tea
